bibl.title: Śukāṣṭakavyākhyāna
bibl.note: Notices of Sanskrit MSS by Rajendralala Mitra. Vol. II, Part I. Calcutta: Baptist Mission Press, 1872.
This work is titled 'Śukāṣṭaka, saṭika' in Notices of Sanskrit MSS by Rajendralala Mitra. Vol. II, Part I. Calcutta: Baptist Mission Press, 1872.

The Śukāṣṭaka is a work of eight verses on jīvanmuktas according to Advaita Vedānta. It is also known as the Vyāsaputrāṣṭaka, Nirvāṇāṣṭaka, Nirvāṇaprakaraṇa, or Śukadevāṣṭaka, and is ascribed to Śukācārya. This work, the Śukāṣṭakavyākhyāna, is a commentary on the Śukāṣṭaka (also known as Nirvāṇāṣṭaka). (See New Catalogus Catalogorum (NCC). Vols 1–36: vol. 5, p. 207a, and vol. 10, p. 23a.)
